Create realistic, production-quality UI design, a single high fidelity desktop Readict ebook reading screen. Target 1920 x 1080, 16:9, content only without browser chrome. Reference image 1 is the current Readict UI: retain its warm ivory background, warm white paper, Georgia English text and muted forest green identity, but improve proportions. Reference image 2 is actual WeChat Read: learn quiet hierarchy, external toolbar and tiny understated paging, NOT its dark theme or two-column reading.
Use a SINGLE centered reading page. No additional panels, metrics, cards, tabs, illustrations or invented features. Top navigation small book-outline icon + Readict | ← 书架. Paper heading "Then There Were None", below "CHAPTER TWO" with delicate short horizontal lines. Georgia body about24px line-height1.8, left aligned. Toolbar OUTSIDE paper on right with24pxgap, only outline contents, bookmark(disabled subtle), settings icons, quiet44px hitarea. Bottom: matching light outline small buttons "‹ 上一页" and "下一页 ›", about75x32px, NOT green filled; centered small "第 8 / 23 页", quiet space underneath reserved for save status without extra visible copy. No translation button. Extremely restrained border and shadow. Use palette canvas#F0EDE7 paper#FFFDFA text#302E2B secondary#716A61 line#DED8CE accent#405B4C. No annotations, labels of concept name, mockup dimensions, fake logos, watermarks, deviceframe or comparison collage. Text is realistic readable English and accurately rendered Chinese controls.
Use SAME reading passage across all concepts exactly:
A chalk outline and a large red stain on the stairwell marked the spot. “What do we know so far?”
“The security system wasn’t breached. Whoever the killer or killers were, either someone admitted them, or they had the gate entry code. Cole pulled the security camera data. Should have a picture if they entered through the front gate.”
“Could they have come over the wall?”
“Cole checked it out,” Turner said. “The rain has washed out any footprints there might have been. The fence is electrified and has razor wire. So it would be difficult to breach, but not impossible.”
Matt glanced over at the security system by the entrance. “The killer must have shut down the system before or after the murders.”
“It was off when we arrived. The smoke alarms would have summoned the police and fire department if the system had been on.”
“What caused the fire?”
